label: Large Cut-Away 8.2 cm
description: The Large Cut-Away at 8.2cm is the boldest of the spread collar family, with the points spread nearly horizontally and the collar opening wide enough to frame even a large Windsor knot without crowding. It projects a thoroughly modern, Italian sensibility — worn open-necked, it creates a dramatic V-opening that feels effortlessly smart. On a formal shirt, it commands attention and pairs particularly well with a double-breasted jacket or a prominent tie knot.
